svg.aria-label: The Instinct composition flow: the same typed question runs Reflex's modelless engine first; a confident fused-gate answer returns in microseconds and the specialist is never paid; an abstain prunes to the top-k candidates, the sealed per-domain specialist scores them, an H1 cascade or H2 prior fusion calibrates the pick, and the answer ships with a decision receipt — while arsenal.toml, the only selection surface, hot-swaps registered arms monotonically
